scope: Two five-request, rate-limited samples of the official Action API random generator; no article extracts are retained.

targeted_alias_probe.cause: The old leading-subject rule did not cover a country name immediately after the copula.

interpretation: All ten sampled batches contained at least four accepted options; the revised five batches also retained at least one usable answer after any four-option draw.
A 50-page generator result does not mean 50 extracts: the installed Extracts module returns at most 20 per request, so the application now states that limit explicitly.
The sample is intentionally small and random. It supports regression decisions, not a permanent estimate of encyclopedia-wide prevalence.
